title: Fall of the School of the Unseen

entities.name: Fall of the School of the Unseen
entities.description: Event of 2954 AR on Terisiare in which the School of the Unseen was destroyed.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: A school of magic holding a bottomless pit of black mana, nearly destroyed.

entities.name: Fall of Soldev
entities.description: Event that directly preceded the fall of the school.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker, first possessed by Mairsil-Lim-Dul, then newly sparked and cleansed; destroys war beasts and cuts the pit's magic.

entities.name: Phyrexian War Beasts
entities.description: Beasts sent to destroy the school.

entities.name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
entities.description: Machines sent to destroy the school, all destroyed by its mages.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Placed the bottomless pit in the school.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: The Magus of the Unseen who destroys a war beast and survives.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Former Archmage of the Unseen who goes with Jaya to the dungeons.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane connected to the bottomless pit.

events.summary: Jaya sends war beasts and steam beasts to destroy the school.
events.quote: The War Beasts and the Steam Beasts immediately set about destroying the school

events.summary: Gerda destroys a war beast; the mages destroy all steam beasts.
events.quote: The mages of the school also succeeded in destroying all of the steam beasts

events.summary: Newly sparked Jaya, cleansed of Mairsil-Lim-Dul, crushes the remaining six war beasts.
events.quote: Jaya lifted the remaining war beasts into the air and crushed them

events.summary: Jaya and Jodah cut the pit's magic, severing its connection to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Jaya was able to cut the source of the magic to the bottomless pit

events.summary: Survivors take the inventory and Jaya guides them far east; Jodah lets his name fade into myth.
events.quote: let Jaya guide them far east, off the continent of Terisiare

relations.quote: the bottomless pit that had been placed in the School of the Unseen by Leshrac
The Magus of the Unseen, Gerda Äagesdotter
Jaya and Jodah then descended to the dungeons of the school
